questions.question: A step annotation lasts longer than its model annotation. What can this alone establish?
options: The accelerator was idle for the entire difference.
The whole difference is input loading.
The step includes time outside the model region; inspect the other regions and lanes to explain it.
questions.explanation: The annotation boundaries establish inclusion, not a universal attribution of the remaining time. Our injected wait is known from code; an actual workload needs trace evidence.
optionFeedback: The difference can include host work, transfers, synchronization or scheduling. Inspect trace lanes before assigning all of it to idle time.
A wide step region alone cannot isolate data loading. Compare input, host and device events within the same time interval.
The annotation boundaries establish inclusion, not a universal attribution of the remaining time. Our injected wait is known from code; an actual workload needs trace evidence.
